title: Nutritional Powder Mix (EAS Whey Protein Powder)

content.title: About
content.content: The Nutritional Powder Mix EAS Whey Protein Powder is a high‑quality whey protein designed to support muscle growth, post‑workout recovery, and increase daily protein intake. The powder mixes easily with water, milk, or juice and has a pleasant flavor.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Whey protein is rapidly absorbed, delivering a quick influx of amino acids to muscles.
EAS was one of the first brands to add digestive enzymes to protein blends for better tolerance.
The formula is low in fat and carbs, making it suitable for low‑calorie diets.
Contains added enzymes (protease, lactase) to improve digestion.
First released in the 1990s, it has earned a strong reputation among athletes.

items.title: Supports muscle growth
items.content: A complete profile of essential amino acids, including BCAAs, promotes muscle‑protein synthesis after training.

items.title: Accelerates recovery
items.content: Whey quickly replenishes glycogen stores and aids repair of damaged muscle fibers.

items.title: Helps weight management
items.content: High protein content increases satiety, helping to reduce overall calorie intake.

items.title: Boosts immunity
items.content: Glutamine and other immune‑supporting components help strengthen the immune system.

items.title: Easy digestion
items.content: Added enzymes facilitate digestion and reduce the risk of stomach discomfort.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: The product contains whey protein, which can trigger allergic reactions in individuals with dairy sensitivities.

items.title: Excessive protein intake
items.content: Consuming too much protein may strain kidneys and liver, especially in people with pre‑existing conditions.

items.title: Artificial sweeteners
items.content: Some versions include sucralose or aspartame, which may be undesirable for sensitive consumers.

items.title: Possible gastrointestinal issues
items.content: Large doses can cause bloating, gas, or diarrhea in some individuals.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Mix one scoop (≈30 g) with 250–300 ml of water, milk, or fruit juice. Take 1–2 servings per day, preferably post‑workout and/or between meals to boost overall protein intake.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place with the package tightly sealed. Keep moisture and direct sunlight away. For extended shelf life, transfer to the refrigerator to maintain freshness.
